005package edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics;
006
007/**
008 * Represents the motor voltages for a mecanum drive drivetrain.
009 *
010 * @deprecated Use {@link
011 *     edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.MecanumControllerCommand.MecanumVoltagesConsumer}
012 */
013@Deprecated(since = "2025", forRemoval = true)
014public class MecanumDriveMotorVoltages {
015  /** Voltage of the front left motor. */
016  public double frontLeftVoltage;
017
018  /** Voltage of the front right motor. */
019  public double frontRightVoltage;
020
021  /** Voltage of the rear left motor. */
022  public double rearLeftVoltage;
023
024  /** Voltage of the rear right motor. */
025  public double rearRightVoltage;
026
027  /** Constructs a MecanumDriveMotorVoltages with zeros for all member fields. */
028  public MecanumDriveMotorVoltages() {}
029
030  /**
031   * Constructs a MecanumDriveMotorVoltages.
032   *
033   * @param frontLeftVoltage Voltage of the front left motor.
034   * @param frontRightVoltage Voltage of the front right motor.
035   * @param rearLeftVoltage Voltage of the rear left motor.
036   * @param rearRightVoltage Voltage of the rear right motor.
037   */
038  public MecanumDriveMotorVoltages(
039      double frontLeftVoltage,
040      double frontRightVoltage,
041      double rearLeftVoltage,
042      double rearRightVoltage) {
043    this.frontLeftVoltage = frontLeftVoltage;
044    this.frontRightVoltage = frontRightVoltage;
045    this.rearLeftVoltage = rearLeftVoltage;
046    this.rearRightVoltage = rearRightVoltage;
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  public String toString() {
051    return String.format(
052        "MecanumDriveMotorVoltages(Front Left: %.2f V, Front Right: %.2f V, "
053            + "Rear Left: %.2f V, Rear Right: %.2f V)",
054        frontLeftVoltage, frontRightVoltage, rearLeftVoltage, rearRightVoltage);
055  }
056}
